FormatMovesString:
	ld hl, wMoves
	ld de, wMovesString
	ld b, $0
.printMoveNameLoop
	ld a, [hli]
	and a ; end of move list?
	jr z, .printDashLoop ; print dashes when no moves are left
	push hl
	ld [wNameListIndex], a
	ld a, BANK(MoveNames)
	ld [wPredefBank], a
	ld a, MOVE_NAME
	ld [wNameListType], a
	call GetName
	ld hl, wNameBuffer
.copyNameLoop
	ld a, [hli]
	cp '@'
	jr z, .doneCopyingName
	ld [de], a
	inc de
	jr .copyNameLoop
.doneCopyingName
	ld a, b
	ld [wNumMovesMinusOne], a
	inc b
	ld a, '<NEXT>'
	ld [de], a
	inc de
	pop hl
	ld a, b
	cp NUM_MOVES
	jr z, .done
	jr .printMoveNameLoop
.printDashLoop
	ld a, '-'
	ld [de], a
	inc de
	inc b
	ld a, b
	cp NUM_MOVES
	jr z, .done
	ld a, '<NEXT>'
	ld [de], a
	inc de
	jr .printDashLoop
.done
	ld a, '@'
	ld [de], a
	ret

	jr nz, .notBag
	ld hl, wNumBagItems
	ld de, ItemNames
	ld a, ITEM_NAME
	jr .done

	ld de, ItemNames

	ld a, l

	ld a, e

	ld a, d
	ld [wUnusedNamePointer + 1], a
	ld bc, ItemPrices
	ld a, c

	ld a, b
	ld [wItemPrices + 1], a
	ret
